headline: Ferry Crossing and Island Life on the Bay of Fundy
reservation: Access requires a ferry crossing from Blacks Harbour; vehicle space is limited and advance booking for the sailing is highly recommended to avoid long standby waits. This travel reservation is separate from island accommodations or campsites. Check the Coastal Transport official site for seasonal schedules and boarding requirements.

days.title: North Head Cliffs and Whales

stops.name: Swallowtail Lighthouse
stops.detail: Walk the wooden footbridge to this iconic 1860 structure for views of the rugged coastline and passing ferries.

stops.name: Whale Watching Departure
stops.detail: Join a local charter from the harbor to observe North Atlantic right whales and humpbacks in the deep Fundy waters.

days.driving: Allow 30–60 minutes for local transit; conditions vary with fog
days.note: Fog can roll in rapidly, obscuring coastal views and slowing travel on the main island road.

days.title: Southern Shores and Secluded Coves

stops.name: Southwest Head
stops.detail: Witness the dramatic basalt cliffs that rise nearly 100 meters above the sea at the island's southern tip.

stops.name: Anchorage Provincial Park
stops.detail: Explore the sandy beaches and hiking trails that connect the coastal peat bogs to the shoreline.

days.driving: Allow 45 minutes; conditions vary by weather
days.note: The southern portion of the island is more exposed to Atlantic winds; dress in layers regardless of the forecast.

days.title: Local Heritage and Geology
days.start: Suggested: 10:00 AM from Grand Manan Museum

stops.name: Grand Manan Museum
stops.detail: Examine the world-renowned bird collection and learn about the island's unique volcanic geological history.

stops.name: Pettes Cove
stops.detail: Search for geological specimens and enjoy a different perspective of the Swallowtail light across the water.

days.driving: Minimal local driving; allow 20 minutes between stops
days.note: Museum hours are seasonal; verify current opening dates before arrival.

intel.title: Ferry Logistics
intel.text: The ferry departs from Blacks Harbour on the mainland; arrive at least 45 minutes before departure. Return sailings from North Head can fill up during Sunday afternoon peaks.

intel.title: Island Supplies
intel.text: Fuel stations are concentrated in the central Grand Harbour area. It is advisable to fill your tank before boarding the ferry as island prices and availability can fluctuate.

intel.title: Tidal Fluctuations
intel.text: The Bay of Fundy has the world's highest tides; check local tide tables before exploring rocky beaches or sea caves. Low tide reveals extensive intertidal zones that are submerged twice daily.

intel.title: Cellular Dead Zones
intel.text: Reception is generally stable in North Head and Grand Harbour but becomes spotty near Southwest Head. Download offline maps before departing the mainland.

intel.title: Lighthouse Access
intel.text: Parking at Swallowtail Lighthouse is located at the top of a steep hill with limited spots. Early morning arrival is suggested for those wishing to avoid a longer walk from the overflow areas.

plan.arrival: Pick up your rental at Saint John Airport (YSJ), drive 45 minutes to Blacks Harbour, and check in for the ferry. Once on the island, stock up on groceries in Grand Harbour before heading to your North Head lodging.
plan.vehicle: A standard passenger car is sufficient for the paved main road; check rental agreements for restrictions on driving on unpaved coastal tracks.
plan.goldenHour: Southwest Head offers a vast horizon for sunset, typically most vibrant in the clear air of late August.
